sortieLines.line: ⚔️ SORTIE — Samrawit, Anyela take up arms and a day's rations (478 kcal from the stores) and walk out to the treeline. Nobody's coming back the same.
⚔️ The Reunion mauled Samrawit (-100 health) over 2 rounds. They're lucky to be breathing. — the party falls back to the palisade, dragging their nerve with them. The treeline holds.

🌙 Night. The lingering Big Big gorges at the treeline — 777 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.
